Title: The Curse of Knowledge in Reasoning About False Beliefs

Title: Learning Impairs the Accuracy of Judgments of Others' Knowledge
Key_Finding: Studying facts reduces the validity of an expert's experiences for predicting a novice's knowledge.

Title: Evaluation of Evidence-Based Practices in Online Learning: A Meta-Analysis
Key_Finding: Purely independent self-directed online learning requires structural compensation to match guided instruction.

Title: A Systematic Schema-Based Instructional Design Model for Self-Paced Online Learning
Key_Finding: Schema-based design using Cognitive Task Analysis prevents cognitive overload in asynchronous environments.

Title: Video Improves Learning in Higher Education: A Systematic Review
Key_Finding: Coherence, segmenting, and learner control are paramount principles for video-based learning environments.

Title: Effective Educational Videos: Principles and Guidelines for Maximizing Student Learning from Video Content
Key_Finding: Keeping videos under 6 minutes and using a conversational tone significantly drives engagement.

Title: Instructor Presence in Video Lectures Engages Neural Synchronization and Improves Learning
Key_Finding: Instructor presence triggers deeper socio-emotional processing that outweighs the visual distraction of the face.

Title: Generative AI vs. Recorded Video: Impacts on Cognitive, Emotional, and Social Perspectives
Key_Finding: Authentic human instructors drive superior emotional and social engagement compared to AI avatars.

Authors: Wisniewski, B., Zierer, K., & Hattie, J.
Title: The Power of Feedback Revisited: A Meta-Analysis of Educational Feedback Research
Key_Finding: High-information feedback vastly outperforms simple reinforcement in driving learning outcomes.

Title: Development of Self-Regulated Learning Through Adaptive Learning Technology
Key_Finding: Adaptive feedback loops improve learner metacognition and digital resource selection.

Title: Synthesizing Feedback Modes: The Influence of Presumptions and Feedback Literacy
Key_Finding: Well-designed peer assessment and self-assessment heavily mediate capability improvements.

Authors: Collins, A., Brown, J. S., & Newman, S. E.
Title: Cognitive Apprenticeship: Teaching the Crafts of Reading, Writing, and Mathematics
Key_Finding: Adapting traditional apprenticeship into the cognitive domain through modeling and fading fosters deep transfer of learning.

Title: A cornerstone of adaptivity: A meta-analysis of the expertise reversal effect
Key_Finding: High instructional assistance helps novices but harms experts, proving course scaffolding must dynamically fade.

Title: Project-Based Learning and Curricular Sequencing
Key_Finding: Project-based learning must be sequenced from simple to complex whole-task projects.

Title: Self-Determination Theory and Online Learning: Advancements, Future Direction, and Research Gaps
Key_Finding: Identifies how Autonomy, Competence, and Relatedness interact uniquely within online learning environments.

Key_Finding: Competence and relatedness drive motivation significantly more than autonomy in self-directed e-learning.

Title: Heutagogy: A Comprehensive Review of Self-Determined Learning in Contemporary Education
Key_Finding: Heutagogy is a definitive framework for modern adult digital education emphasizing double-loop learning and capability.

Authors: Ericsson, K. A., Krampe, R. T., & Tesch-Römer, C.
Title: The Role of Deliberate Practice in the Acquisition of Expert Performance
